name: Kalends
description: Kalends is a full-screen wall calendar for a spare display or a dashboard iframe. It merges Google and Microsoft accounts (optional sign-in) and any number of iCal feeds (TeamSnap, iCloud, Sonarr, Radarr) into one colour-coded month grid with a big clock, today's agenda and an Open-Meteo forecast, all configured from a web settings page.

notes.text: Open /settings first to create the admin password; until then anyone on the network can set it.
Google and Microsoft accounts: Settings → Accounts → Sign in. Other calendars (TeamSnap, iCloud, Sonarr…) are added by pasting their iCal link.
